extraction_scope.policy: direct mechanism only for source-backed assays; analogy/speculation remains contextual.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Isopedopeptin F (compound 6); inferred family relevance limited to structural analogy
mechanism_claims.claim_text: Compound 6 directly caused leakage in an E. coli phospholipid liposome assay, supporting membrane permeabilization as an antibacterial mechanism for the tested isopedopeptin.
direct_assay_types: E. coli phospholipid liposome leakage/permeabilization assay
mechanism_claims.limitations: The direct assay used compound 6, not every isopedopeptin; shared-family mechanism remains an inference from structural similarity.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses possible membrane/LPS-related activity by analogy to pedopeptins and polymyxins, but does not provide a direct LPS-binding assay for isopedopeptins.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote this LPS discussion to a direct mechanism claim.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Resistance-frequency experiments did not recover resistant mutants, so mutant sequencing did not identify an additional mechanism for compound 2.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Negative resistance result supports low observed resistance frequency but not a molecular target assignment.
